mapper.sql:
o.is_delete = 0
and o.member_id in
#{memberId}
and (o.order_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.external_order_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.customer_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.customer_phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.recipient_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or o.recipient_phone like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
and o.create_time >= concat(#{beginTime}, ' 00:00:00')
and o.create_time < date_add(concat(#{endTime}, ' 00:00:00'), interval 1 day)
mapper.select: select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where

select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.tenant_id, o.member_id, o.shop_name as source_shop_name, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.recipient_name, o.recipient_phone, date_format(o.lease_start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as lease_start_date, date_format(o.lease_end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as lease_end_date, o.rent_amount, o.deposit_amount, o.order_status, date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time from ry_business.ry_rental_order o where order by o.create_time desc, o.order_id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select o.tenant_id as tenantId, o.member_id as memberId, o.order_id as orderId, o.order_no as orderNo, o.external_order_no as externalOrderNo, o.shop_name as shopName, o.customer_name as customerName, o.customer_phone as customerPhone, o.recipient_name as recipientName, o.recipient_phone as recipientPhone, o.recipient_address as recipientAddress, o.lease_start_date as leaseStartDate, o.lease_end_date as leaseEndDate, o.warehouse_id as warehouseId, o.return_warehouse_id as returnWarehouseId, o.ship_due_time as shipDueTime, o.return_due_time as returnDueTime, o.delivery_method as deliveryMethod, o.return_delivery_method as returnDeliveryMethod, o.delivery_amount as deliveryAmount, o.insurance_amount as insuranceAmount, o.lease_days as leaseDays, o.arrival_date as arrivalDate, o.create_time as createTime, o.rent_amount as rentAmount, o.deposit_amount as depositAmount, o.order_status as orderStatus, o.pay_status as payStatus, o.time_effect_status as timeEffectStatus, o.priority_flag as priorityFlag, o.weather_risk_flag as weatherRiskFlag, o.remark as remark, o.remark as customerNote, o.package_details_json as packageDetailsJson, oi.order_item_id as orderItemId, oi.product_id as productId, oi.package_id as packageId, oi.sn_id as snId, oi.accessory_item_ids as accessoryItemIds, oi.quantity as quantity, product.product_name as productName, product.model_name as modelName, product.product_code as productCode, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.package_details_json, '$.packageName')) as packageName, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, return_warehouse.warehouse_name as returnWarehouseName, w.city as warehouseCity, (select l.carrier from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.order_id = o.order_id and l.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and l.member_id = o.member_id and l.direction = 1 and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.create_time desc, l.logistics_id desc limit 1) as shippingCarrier, (select l.tracking_no from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.order_id = o.order_id and l.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and l.member_id = o.member_id and l.direction = 1 and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.create_time desc, l.logistics_id desc limit 1) as shippingTrackingNo, (select l.carrier from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.order_id = o.order_id and l.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and l.member_id = o.member_id and l.direction = 2 and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.create_time desc, l.logistics_id desc limit 1) as returnCarrier, (select l.tracking_no from ry_business.ry_rental_logistics_order l where l.order_id = o.order_id and l.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and l.member_id = o.member_id and l.direction = 2 and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.create_time desc, l.logistics_id desc limit 1) as returnTrackingNo from ry_business.ry_rental_order o left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id and oi.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and oi.member_id = o.member_id and oi.is_delete = 0 and oi.order_item_id = ( select min(first_item.order_item_id) from ry_business.ry_rental_order_item first_item where first_item.order_id = o.order_id and first_item.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and first_item.member_id = o.member_id and first_item.is_delete = 0 ) left join ry_business.ry_rental_product product on product.product_id = oi.product_id and product.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and product.member_id = o.member_id and product.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and w.member_id = o.member_id and w.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse return_warehouse on return_warehouse.warehouse_id = o.return_warehouse_id and return_warehouse.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and return_warehouse.member_id = o.member_id and return_warehouse.is_delete = 0 where o.order_id = #{orderId} and o.is_delete = 0 limit 1

select n.note_content as noteContent, n.note_type as noteType, '商户操作人' as operatorName, date_format(n.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_note n where n.order_id = #{orderId} and n.is_delete = 0 order by n.create_time desc, n.note_id desc

select oi.order_item_id as orderItemId, oi.quantity, oi.item_status as itemStatus, p.product_type as productType, p.product_name as itemName, p.product_code as itemCode, p.model_name as modelName, u.serial_number as serialNumber, u.unit_code as inventoryCode from ry_business.ry_rental_order_item oi left join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = oi.product_id and p.tenant_id = oi.tenant_id and p.member_id = oi.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_inventory_unit u on u.unit_id = oi.sn_id and u.tenant_id = oi.tenant_id and u.member_id = oi.member_id and u.is_delete = 0 where oi.order_id = #{orderId} and oi.is_delete = 0 order by oi.order_item_id

select inspection_result as result, case_type as caseType, problem_desc as problemDesc, lost_items_json as lostItemsJson, compensation_amount as compensationAmount, customer_contacted as customerContacted, remark, date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as inspectedTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_return_inspection where order_id = #{orderId} and is_delete = 0 order by create_time desc, inspection_id desc limit 1

select l.field_name as fieldName, l.before_display_value as beforeDisplayValue, l.after_display_value as afterDisplayValue, l.change_reason as changeReason, l.operator_name as operatorName, l.operator_ip as operatorIp, date_format(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime from ry_business.ry_rental_order_edit_log l where l.order_id = #{orderId} and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.create_time desc, l.log_id desc
